t: A drag-and-drop simulator of neural circuits using integrate-and-fire neurons.
steps: Find the Neuronify website and download the installer for your system.
Ask IT to approve the install on classroom computers.
Install from the Ubuntu Software Center or Snap on Linux.
Open the app and build a simple circuit with two neurons.
Test the camera sensing on one device.
Check the cost and support page before a school-wide rollout.
Plan a short activity that asks students to predict what a change will do.
